All water solutions

Water filtration for the whole home.

A whole-house system treats water where it enters the home. Explore a starting point for the water at your kitchen, bathroom, laundry, and other household taps.

Schedule a Water Consultation

Start at the source.

Whole-home filtration is also called point-of-entry filtration. A system is installed on the main supply line, rather than at one drinking-water tap. The right configuration depends on what is in the source water, the household’s flow needs, and the specific concern you want to address.

Florida Pure Solutions offers whole-house filtration systems. A consultation helps establish the right scope before you compare equipment, installation requirements, or pricing.

Filtration and softening do different jobs.

Water filtration and water softening are not interchangeable. If spots or scale are your main concern, ask about a hardness test and whether a separate treatment approach is needed. A filter should not be assumed to remove hardness minerals.

Ask for the exact proposed model, its performance data, any independently certified reduction claims, and the maintenance instructions. No single filter treats every possible concern.

Prepare for an installation conversation.

Have your water source, recent test results, household size, and approximate main-line location ready. Photos of the installation area can help clarify space and access. Suitability and plumbing needs must be checked for your home.

Ask what the written quote includes: the system, installation work, any site-specific changes, startup checks, replacement filters or media, and future maintenance. This site does not quote installation costs or promise a specific result before review.

Three questions to bring along.

  1. Is my water source and the target concern compatible with this model?
  2. How will this system affect household flow, and how is it sized?
  3. What needs replacing, how often, and at what ongoing cost?

A dedicated kitchen system may still be worth discussing when drinking and cooking water are the focus.
